note: Paired revision execution on the real build step path. Each case seeds a prior plan into the build branch and the plan table, then rejects it through POST /api/builds/:id/steps {action:'revision'} so the replan prompt carries the feedback. The feedback arm must reach the artifact: a new plan version whose Changes section drops the rejected approach, names the real cause, and keeps requirements that were already correct. The no-feedback control runs the same revision from equivalent isolated state with the feedback withheld and must fail those requirements. expect.defect and expect.drop are checked inside the Changes section only; expect.keep is checked on the whole document. Assistant prose never counts. Missing or failed steps are harness errors, never a score.

cases.prompt: Export button does nothing on Safari. Plan the fix and cover verification.
cases.priorPlan:
## Context
Kind: fix
Safari ignores the download attribute on a blob URL, so the export silently does nothing.

## Changes
Append more logging around the download path.

## Edge cases
